BEGIN READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='5s'; SET LOCAL lock_timeout='500ms';
WITH hints(hint,pattern) AS (VALUES ('water_candidate','%agua%'),('yogurt_candidate','%yogur%'),('potato_candidate','%patata%')),
samples AS (SELECT 'mercadona'::text AS store,h.hint,to_jsonb(p) AS product FROM hints h CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id::text,display_name,packaging::text,unit_price,price_per_unit::text,ean::text,published,synced_at FROM public.mercadona_products WHERE published AND display_name ILIKE h.pattern ORDER BY id LIMIT 6) p
UNION ALL
SELECT 'carrefour'::text AS store,h.hint,to_jsonb(p) AS product FROM hints h CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id::text,display_name,NULL::text AS packaging,unit_price,price_per_unit::text,ean::text,published,synced_at FROM public.carrefour_products WHERE published AND display_name ILIKE h.pattern ORDER BY id LIMIT 6) p
UNION ALL
SELECT 'consum'::text AS store,h.hint,to_jsonb(p) AS product FROM hints h CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id::text,display_name,packaging::text,unit_price,price_per_unit::text,ean::text,published,synced_at FROM public.consum_products WHERE published AND display_name ILIKE h.pattern ORDER BY id LIMIT 6) p
UNION ALL
SELECT 'plusfresc'::text AS store,h.hint,to_jsonb(p) AS product FROM hints h CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id::text,display_name,NULL::text AS packaging,unit_price,price_per_unit::text,NULL::text AS ean,published,synced_at FROM public.plusfresc_products WHERE published AND display_name ILIKE h.pattern ORDER BY id LIMIT 6) p)
SELECT jsonb_build_object('captured_at',now(),'selection','first six active rows by id per store/lexical hint; not random, not validated families','products',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) ORDER BY store,hint,product->>'id') FROM samples s)) evidence;
ROLLBACK;
